issues.title: Decky Loader 3.2.9 and 3.2.10-pre1 skip the cleanup of other plugins
issues.body: When Decky stops a plugin, its socket loop spins and the plugin is killed after 5 s, so an uninstall often skips the plugin's own cleanup. Ally Companion works around it and takes over what Ally Fix and Ally DSP left behind.
